item.description: The Floyd County Museum put on an illuminating program on Saturday, March 21, as this month’s Chautauqua Talk discussed the history of Charles City’s mills. item.title: Decorah School District proposes forming another athletic conference - Enterprise Media
item.description: The Decorah Community School District Board of Directors approved a formal application to the Iowa Conference Realignment Committee on Monday, requesting the formation of a new high school athletic conference. The application was presented to the board by Decorah School District Activities Director Adam Riley during a special meeting Monday afternoon.
